title: Tenant/workload isolation enforcement

subparts.name: compute/process isolation controls
subparts.blocker: node runtime enforcement (cgroups/namespaces/seccomp or hypervisor); only admission-time policy check exists

subparts.name: memory/resource isolation controls
subparts.blocker: cgroup/hypervisor memory+CPU enforcement on real nodes

subparts.name: network/identity isolation controls
subparts.blocker: network policy enforcement point and workload identity issuer (SPIFFE/CA)

subparts.name: device/accelerator isolation controls
subparts.blocker: IOMMU/MIG/device-plugin enforcement on real accelerator nodes

notes: State isolation enforced in-process; other boundaries are a policy checker only.
